# windowsddi_dns_zone (Data Source)

Looks up one DNS zone by name (`Get-DnsServerZone`): primary zones, conditional forwarders and any other zone type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "windowsddi_dns_zone" "lab" {
  name = "lab.example.local"
}

output "lab_is_ad_integrated" {
  value = data.windowsddi_dns_zone.lab.ad_integrated
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone name to look up, for example `lab.example.local` or `20.1.10.in-addr.arpa`. Casing and a trailing dot are ignored. Kept as written.

### Read-Only

- `ad_integrated` (Boolean) Whether the zone is stored in Active Directory.
- `dynamic_update` (String) Dynamic update mode (`None`, `Secure` or `NonsecureAndSecure`). Null for zone types without one.
- `forwarder_timeout` (Number) Forwarder timeout in seconds for a conditional forwarder, null otherwise.
- `master_servers` (List of String) Master servers of a conditional forwarder, in order. Empty for other zone types.
- `replication_scope` (String) AD replication scope (`Forest`, `Domain`, `Legacy` or `Custom`). Null when the zone is not AD-integrated.
- `reverse` (Boolean) Whether the zone is a reverse lookup zone.
- `zone_file` (String) Zone file name for file-backed zones, null otherwise.
- `zone_type` (String) Zone type as reported by `Get-DnsServerZone`: `Primary`, `Secondary`, `Stub` or `Forwarder` (conditional forwarder).
